nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV): Overview

Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a respiratory pathogen from the Paramyxoviridae family that causes acute respiratory infections in individuals of all ages, particularly young children, immunocompromised individuals, and the elderly.
